subject: Order Form: billing acceptance matrix, invoicing fallback & VAT handling (Cythera)
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@cytherahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@cytherahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order Form questions — invoice routing, net terms, VAT

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the draft order form. Procurement has two quick operational questions before we loop in legal:

- Which Redwood entity will issue the invoice (US vs Redwood EU)? We need to map invoicing to our AP entity to avoid cross-entity tax issues.
- Can Redwood accept Net 45 for Cythera’s EU entity? Our standard is Net 45 for pilot contracts. If not, can we set a 45/30 split (EMEA 45 / US 30)?
- Tax: we expect to handle VAT reverse-charge where applicable. Who will be responsible for VAT registration/evidence?

I attached our PO (Cythera_PO_4512.pdf). We also want to confirm the acceptance window for invoices — our AR team needs 30 days to process disputed invoices.

Please advise route and whether Redwood needs any tax forms from us. If helpful we can jump on a 20-min call later today.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager
Cythera Health

Attachment: Cythera_PO_4512.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@cytherahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form questions — invoice routing, net terms, VAT

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Quick proposal so we can keep procurement moving and give legal a clear ask to review:

Proposed billing matrix (high level):
- If customer invoice entity = Cythera, Inc. (US) -> Redwood, Inc. (US) issues invoice, Net 30 USD, standard tax handling (no VAT).
- If customer invoice entity = Cythera Europe Ltd. (EMEA) -> Redwood EU issues invoice, Net 45 EUR, customer responsible for VAT reverse-charge where applicable.
- If Cythera needs a single invoice to a non-resident entity, we can do a consolidated billing with invoicing entity determined by tax residency; in those cases Redwood requests the customer provide tax residency evidence (VAT ID / W9) prior to first invoice.

Operational notes / asks for legal redline:
- Add clause: "Invoice acceptance window: Customer must notify Redwood of a disputed invoice within 30 days of the invoice date; undisputed amounts are payable per the Net Terms."
- Add fallback: "If local withholding is required by law, customer will notify Redwood and provide evidence; Redwood will cooperate to minimize gross-up but cannot accept automatic withholding that reduces payment without prior agreement."

I attached our W9 for your AP team and have added the draft order form with highlighted invoice-routing section (Cythera_OrderForm_v3.pdf).

Kimberly — can you please review the two bullets above and suggest specific redline language re: withholding, VAT, and invoice acceptance timeframe? Ben — any concerns from billing systems side (PO mapping / remittance emails)?

If everyone is aligned I’ll push the redlines into DocuSign and send to Alyssa for signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (text/plain, 4KB), Cythera_OrderForm_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@cytherahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Nov 2028 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form questions — invoice routing, net terms, VAT (legal redlines)

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks, Marissa, for the concise matrix. Below are legal redline suggestions we can insert into the order form; I’ve kept the language narrow and operational to avoid re-opening MSA-level tax indemnities.

1) Invoice entity / remittance
- Proposed text: "Seller shall issue invoices from the Redwood entity listed on the Order Form. Customer shall remit payment to the bank account specified on the invoice. If Customer requests invoices from an alternate Redwood entity, Customer must provide valid tax residency documentation and prior written consent from Seller; Seller reserves the right to decline where doing so creates material tax exposure."

2) Net terms / credit check
- Proposed text: "Standard payment terms are Net 30 from invoice date for invoices issued by Redwood, Inc. For invoices issued by Redwood (EMEA) BV, Net 45 may be requested; such extended terms are subject to Seller’s credit approval and may require prepayment or an agreed-upon deposit for pilot engagements."

3) Invoice acceptance / dispute window
- Proposed text: "Customer must notify Seller in writing of any disputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date, providing reasonable detail. Failure to timely dispute an invoice shall constitute acceptance and such invoice shall be payable according to the payment terms."

4) VAT / withholding
- Proposed text: "Unless otherwise required by law, Customer shall not withhold any taxes from payments due to Seller. Where withholding is required by law, Customer shall provide official documentation evidencing the withholding and allow Seller to seek applicable tax credits or refunds. Where VAT reverse charge applies, Customer shall be responsible for reporting and payment to local tax authorities and shall provide Seller with the Customer VAT identification number prior to the first invoice."

5) Practical ops notes for Ben (billing):
- Please add a 2-line field in the invoice metadata for Customer VAT ID and Remit Entity so we can automate routing.
- If Net 45 is granted, configure follow-up reminders at 30 and 40 days to avoid accidental write-offs; we can also configure a workflow in Stripe/Aria for split-entity routing.

I’ll prepare a clean redline version of the order form with those exact paragraphs and send to Marissa for DocuSign. Assuming Alyssa can supply the customer VAT ID and PO number we should be able to finalize.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_orderform_redlines.docx (referenced, draft)

Marissa / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed the suggested clauses with Tom (legal) and procurement is comfortable with the matrix and wording, subject to two final asks:

1) Cythera will provide VAT ID for Cythera Europe Ltd. and a W9 for Cythera, Inc. prior to first invoice.
2) We accept Net 45 for EMEA invoices as a one-time concession for this pilot (deal CYT-1951) provided Redwood confirms the invoice will list EMEA entity and the PO number on the invoice.

Can you: (a) include an invoice metadata line for PO number; (b) send the final redline into DocuSign today so we can route for signature tomorrow morning? We’d like the invoice remittance email to be billing@cytherahealth.com.

If you send DocuSign I’ll mark procurement as ready and Tom will confirm legal sign-off on his side once he sees the final doc.

Thanks — Alyssa
